subject.title: [Bug]: Slack draft preview streaming is suppressed by custom outbound identity

question: Is live Slack evidence required to show that a custom username and avatar survive multiple `chat.update` calls before the linked PR may remove the identity guard?
rationale: Source and unit tests establish draft initialization and identity forwarding, but they cannot settle Slack's externally rendered authorship behavior after message edits.

options.title: Require Live Slack Proof
options.body: Verify a custom username, icon URL, and icon emoji through the initial post and multiple draft edits before changing the guard.

options.title: Keep Identity Priority
options.body: Retain the current guard and document that custom outbound identity disables portable draft previews.

options.title: Favor Preview Streaming
options.body: Remove the guard and intentionally accept any authorship normalization Slack applies during subsequent edits.

recommendation.title: Require Live Slack Proof
recommendation.body: Verify a custom username, icon URL, and icon emoji through the initial post and multiple draft edits before changing the guard.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent Slack streaming and delivery work is closest to the dispatch selection and output-ownership boundary under review.
